ImageDescription.value:
This photograph is of the entrance to the magnificent Agnigarh Hill in Tezpur. It is one of the most visited places of mythological as well as historical importance in Assam. The hill is about 200 metres high, over which a beautiful park is opened a few years ago. Atop the hill, also lies a viewpoint from which the aerial view of the green and scenic town of Tezpur can be seen.
Author: Anupom Bora, Tezpur
